observation_indicators.observable_fil: Magbigay ng maikling factual na handover at hilinging kumpirmahin ang susunod na hakbang.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Deliver a timed, factual handover and invite the receiving worker to confirm the next action.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag magdagdag ng hinulaang diagnosis, kaligtaan ang oras o ginawa, o ibahagi ang detalye sa labas ng handover.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not add a guessed diagnosis, omit the time or actions, or share identifiable details outside the care handover.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Magbigay ng maikling factual na handover at hilinging kumpirmahin ang susunod na hakbang. Nagawa nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the task without prompting: Deliver a timed, factual handover and invite the receiving worker to confirm the next action.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang tugon ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa referral o hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Performs the response but needs a prompt about referral or scope.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag magdagdag ng hinulaang diagnosis, kaligtaan ang oras o ginawa, o ibahagi ang detalye sa labas ng handover.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not add a guessed diagnosis, omit the time or actions, or share identifiable details outside the care handover.
